sources.title: AI in Agriculture 2026: Complete Guide to Smart Farming with AI
sources.snippet: AI in Agriculture 2026: Complete Guide to Smart Farming with AI Artificial intelligence is quietly transforming one of humanity’s oldest industries. Across farms in Iowa, vineyards in Bordeaux, and rice paddies in Southeast Asia, AI-powered systems are helping farmers grow more food with less water, fewer chemicals, and lower costs.

sources.snippet: By addressing both technological opportunities and existing barriers, this review contributes to the growing body of knowledge on data-driven agriculture, offering a comprehensive and evidence-based perspective on the future of IoT and AI in smart farming.
